purpose: Product reveal or book shot (beat 8 product intro, demonstration, CTA support). Book campaigns use the U10 orientation contract and the U11 printed-page block.
camera_default: [Static shot]; a slow [Push in] is the only allowed move
first_frame_rule: The first frame is made FROM the client's cover/product file (composited or image-to-image), never a cover the model invents (U10 contract rule 7).
text_rule: No readable title is asked of the video model; the cover lettering comes from the first frame and must stay unchanged; exact words are overlaid in post and read back by OCR (U9).
negatives: no duplicated covers or extra books
no book rotation over fifteen degrees
beats_pattern: hands enter -> contact and the one motion (open / lift / turn one page) -> settle and hold on the product
